note: Play the stages in order. Stage 1 comes first: protect the one possibly missable trophy in Chapter 1, then play the story straight through. Everything after the story can be done in any order, and the 100% checklist only opens after the credits. Sources: PowerPyx (200 hours, 3 steps), KeenGamer, GTABase, Push Square.

stages.prerequisite: None — start a new game. Keep cheats off: cheats disable trophies and saving.
stages.summary: Play Chapters 1 to 5 in order, 60-80 hours. Every story trophy pops as you finish its chapter or mission. Do side content as it appears: scan vehicles with WAiNK, study animals with binoculars, and take optional missions when they show up — progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even though you cannot see it yet.
stages.title: Story first — protect the one missable trophy
stages.warning: POINT OF NO RETURN: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony to meditate. It is the only possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude) — the Chapter 1 meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots).

stages.prerequisite: Story progress — contacts appear as you play; character switching unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
stages.summary: Finish the five contact strands — Andy (Lucia only, Chapter 3), Kenton (treasure diving), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (16 sports cars) and Tyrone (Jason only, destroy the labs) — plus Bret's hunt and Cal's fishing challenge, and 8 stranger strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more). None of these count as strangers for each other: contact lines do not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
stages.title: Contacts and strangers
stages.warning: Quest givers can go quiet for a chapter (Kenton after Chapter 1), but PowerPyx confirms they all come back, so nothing here is missable. Do each strand when it is offered rather than leaving it.

stages.prerequisite: Story complete — the checklist only unlocks after the credits.
stages.summary: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through it — about 100 hours. The checklist is lenient (closer to 60% true completion): only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. The rest is partial: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts.
stages.title: 100% Completion Checklist — the long grind
stages.warning: Do not burn out here: the checklist is the hardest trophy (A Long Road) and the long pole of the platinum. Fold collecting into travel and do the required-everything lines first.

stages.prerequisite: Partner play unlocks after Coffee Break (Chapter 2); bank vaults after That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4).
stages.summary: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 locations and 20 different races, finish an arcade game, try all 9 activity types, and do the crime set: 5 bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected, 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, a 4-star escape with your partner, one illegal operation per gang, 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, and the money pair ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent).
stages.title: Activities, crime and money
stages.warning: Some of these need your partner beside you — call them with hold Right + Triangle. The 4-star escape is easiest in the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, Kelly County.

stages.prerequisite: Free-roam after the story; garages after Daily Driver (Chapter 2); Scooter Bros after the Moses mission (Chapter 2).
stages.summary: Mop up the open-world secrets now that methods are confirmed — the VCIA airliner, the Mile Zero tank, Kingpin Bowling's 3 valuables, max Strength with both characters — plus the still-unconfirmed five (Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom smash, Payday Loans, UFO, motorcycle melee), which the guide flags honestly with no invented steps. Buy the 8 garages, register 10 vehicles, and when the checklist reads 54 of 54, the platinum pops.
stages.title: Secrets, property and the platinum
stages.warning: Five trophies are still unconfirmed across all guides. Do not trust a specific location for them until a second guide confirms it — check the dispute panel on each one.
